2. Voting rights for such representatives in Panchayats are voluntary.
3. Financial powers such as taxation and grants are constitutionally guaranteed in an identical form in every State.

o: Bodies completely independent of State legislation
Institutions concerned only with rural taxation
Subordinate administrative offices without electoral protection
Constitutionally recognised and justiciable institutions of grassroots democracy
x: The amendment gave Panchayati Raj Institutions constitutional status and made their key democratic arrangements justiciable. States became constitutionally obliged to hold elections rather than being free to discontinue them.
tq: Translate the institutional consequence into its practical effect on State governments.
